flaws.locator: Proposition 5.3 (Subsection 5.1; unlabelled in v5, prop.5.3 in v6), statement: the hypotheses 'X a nilpotent space whose first n homotopy groups are finite, |pi_i X| < infinity for i <= n, and R any commutative ring' (v5), where v6 requires X nilpotent, n-connective, of finite type over R, with pi_n X finite; the conclusion (the natural equivalence of chain complexes between the factorization homology of M with coefficients in C^*(X, R) and C^*(X^M, R)) is unchanged

Proposition 5.3, proof, the convergence step 'By Dwyer [dwyer], the convergence of this Eilenberg-Moore spectral sequence is assured if the base X^{S^k x R^{n-k}} and the fibrations in the diagram are nilpotent. However, by [nilpotent], the space of maps X^K is nilpotent for any K if X is nilpotent ...': Dwyer's theorem is applied where its hypotheses (a connected base, a nilpotent pi_1-action on the homotopy of the fibre) are not supplied by the v5 hypotheses; v6 derives both from n-connectivity
